They are the oldest works of Western literature and have helped establish the types of stories that would come after them.

The philosophical works of Plato and Aristotle have also had a significant influence on literature, particularly in terms of the representation of the human condition and the nature of society. Neil Gaiman’s American Gods, includes a character who represents the god of technology who speaks in philosophical terms about dualism and Cartesian perspectives.
